verdict: 126 leads at $6.16 each, but cost per lead is rising sharply.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 126 leads entirely through Meta at an average cost per lead of $6.16. In the most recent 7 days, however, spend more than doubled while leads grew only 35% — pushing your cost per lead up 54% in that window, a gap that means efficiency is moving in the wrong direction. Two root issues are driving this: all active spend is running through a single campaign, which creates outsized exposure when that campaign loses steam, and delivery has been intermittent, including a zero-spend day on October 6th. We're working to introduce a second campaign to distribute spend and reduce dependency on one line, while stabilising daily delivery so momentum stays consistent. You should also expect a direct conversation about several planned build-outs — including search campaigns and dedicated landing pages — that are behind their original schedule; those pieces, once live, are what broaden your lead sources beyond Meta.
